mechanism: Both drugs are corticosteroid-sparing agents with immunosuppressive and anti-inflammatory properties; combined use may potentiate immunosuppression and increase infection risk, and medroxyprogesterone may inhibit betamethasone metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for signs of immunosuppression and infection; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if betamethasone levels require optimization; no dose adjustment typically required but increased clinical vigilance is warranted.
